fields.label: Outlet Type
fields.description: Set by the operator to match what was actually sold — not client self-service.

fields.label: Hub Mode
fields.description: Standard tier = Cloud Hub. Premium tier = Edge Hub (Tech Architecture §2). Set by the operator to match the subscription actually sold — not client self-service; changing it means re-pairing every device at this outlet.

fields.label: Hub URL
fields.description: Learned by devices only at pairing time — never baked into a build.

fields.label: Hub Push Secret
fields.description: Signs what ERPNext pushes to this outlet's Hub (ticket P3-27). Created on first use, rotated from the Rotate push secret button; handed to the Hub only through its authenticated pull.

fields.label: Previous Hub Push Secret
fields.description: Still accepted by the Hub for one hour after a rotation.

fields.label: Branch
fields.description: Tags every synced Sales Invoice (and its GL Entries) with this outlet as an Accounting Dimension — without it, multi-outlet sales/GL can't be told apart in standard ERPNext reports (P&L, General Ledger, etc.). One Branch per Outlet, same short code by convention.

fields.label: GSTIN
fields.description: 15 characters; must match the state of GSTIN Address. Validated on save (P1-22).

fields.label: Invoice Series Prefix
fields.description: e.g. KOR/26-27/ — format itself is pending client confirmation (P0-22).

fields.label: Business Hours Day Ends
fields.description: A bill settled after midnight posts to the previous business date.

fields.label: GST Rate Pct
fields.description: A single flat rate for the seed menu. Inclusive/exclusive and the rate itself are pending client confirmation (P0-21) — this is a working default, synced to the Hub's bill maths.

fields.label: GST Inclusive
fields.description: Whether menu prices already include GST. Pending client confirmation (P0-21).

fields.label: Service Charge Pct
fields.description: Whether GST applies on it is pending client confirmation (P0-21).

fields.label: UPI VPA (Payee Address)
fields.description: e.g. outlet@okaxis — shown as a static QR on an Edge Hub when the internet is down and the cashier confirms a UPI payment manually (Tech Architecture §10, ticket P4-14). Not used on Cloud Hubs.

fields.label: UPI Payee Name
fields.description: Shown to the guest's UPI app when scanning the static QR. Defaults to the outlet name if left blank.

fields.label: Receipt Printer
fields.description: Ticket P2-18: where bills/receipts print and the cash drawer is kicked from (its drawer port). Kitchen tickets go to each Station's own printer instead.

fields.label: Guest Orders Need Waiter Approval
fields.description: Ticket P2-31: when on, a table's FIRST guest-app order waits for a waiter to approve it before it reaches the bill; later orders from that seating go straight through. Off by default - a working default, the client's call (Security & Access section 4 calls it optional).
